patterns.root_cause: Cluster ID invalid or cluster deleted
patterns.prevention: Cache cluster ID at provisioning time

patterns.root_cause: Worker node unreachable: kubelet down or network partition

fix.action: Inspect node: hcloud CCE showNode --cluster_id {{output.cluster_id}} --node_id {{output.node_id}}; check kubelet + network

patterns.prevention: Monitor node_ready via CES; alarm at <0.8

patterns.root_cause: Insufficient cluster resources or node selector mismatch

fix.action: Describe pod events: hcloud CCE showPod --cluster_id {{output.cluster_id}} --namespace {{output.ns}} --name {{output.pod}}; check node capacity

patterns.prevention: Set HPA + resource requests/limits on all deployments

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-iam-ops for quota raise

patterns.prevention: Check quota via showQuota before bulk node add

patterns.root_cause: SWR image tag missing or auth failed

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-swr-ops to verify/push image; verify pull secret

patterns.prevention: Pre-pull images to local registry; cache tags

patterns.root_cause: API rate limit on CCE control plane
No available PV or storage class misconfigured

fix.action: hcloud CCE listPvcs --cluster_id {{output.cluster_id}}; check storage class + CSI driver

patterns.prevention: Validate storage class in deployment manifest

patterns.root_cause: CCE addon installation failed: chart repo unreachable or version mismatch

fix.action: Retry with explicit version: hcloud CCE installAddon --cluster_id {{output.id}} --addon {{output.name}} --version {{output.v}}

patterns.prevention: Pin addon versions; mirror chart repos

patterns.root_cause: Conflicting NetworkPolicy rules blocking pod-to-pod traffic

fix.action: List NetworkPolicies: kubectl get networkpolicy -A; dedupe overlapping selectors

patterns.root_cause: Control plane etcd unhealthy: disk pressure or quorum loss

fix.action: Escalate to CCE support; do not attempt repair (risk of data loss)

patterns.prevention: Monitor etcd metrics; alarm on leader changes > 5/min
